in_sanskrit.name: सुहान
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सु (su) - Good, Pleasant हान (hān) - Free from, Absent Therefore, Suhaan means 'Free from sorrow, Good, Pleasant, Happy'

in_marathi.name: Suhaan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Good, prosperous, fortunate
in_marathi.long_meaning: Suhaan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Suhaan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘su’, which means good, and ‘haan’, which means prosperous or fortunate. The name is thus a combination of the two, signifying a person who is blessed with good fortune and prosperity.
